[[File:Goblin chathead.png|left|95px]]
'''Goblins''' are generally weak monsters who are popular for [[combat training]] for players with lower [[combat level]]s. They are most easily found in the [[Goblin Cave]], north-west of the [[Manor Farm]] and south-east of [[Fishing Guild]]. Some [[Goblin (Lumbridge)|variants]] are found east of [[Lumbridge]]. Some [[Goblin (God Wars Dungeon)|variants]] are found in the [[God Wars Dungeon]].

==Champion's Challenge==
Goblins are one of the 'races' that have champions in the [[Champion's Challenge]], a [[Distractions and Diversions|Distraction and Diversion]]. To fight the [[Goblin Champion]], the player must kill goblins until one drops a [[Goblin Champion's scroll|Champion's scroll]], a very rare drop.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Havenhythe Out Now|date=23 March 2026}}
** Added to [[Deserted Mine]].

* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Early-Game Rebalance|date=16 February 2026}}
** A number of early-game mobs will once again drop actual armour, weapons, ores, and bars.
*** Tiny plated bronze salvage → Bronze med helm, Bronze gauntlets
*** Tiny spiky bronze salvage → Bronze spear, Bronze dagger/Bronze off hand dagger
*** Small plated bronze salvage → Bronze square shield (level 2), Bronze full helm (level 5)
*** Small bladed bronze salvage → Bronze scimitar/Bronze off hand scimitar
*** Medium plated bronze salvage → Bronze kiteshield
*** Small plated iron salvage → Iron full helm, Iron square shield

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (19 December 2012)|date=19 December 2012}}
** Several goblins have been graphically updated to the same standard as the recently reworked goblins.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=What's Mine is Yours|date=17 October 2012}}
** The Goblin Village has also received a full graphical rework, as have all surface-dwelling goblin NPCs, the [[Captured Temple|Chaos Temple]] near [[Doric's hut|Doric's house]] and the [[Burthorpe]] wall north-west of [[Falador]].

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (13 May 2010)|date=13 May 2010}}
** Goblin death animations should now be a bit quicker.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Runescape beta is now online!|date=4 January 2001}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
* Some common goblins have a "talk" option such as the one in the hay barn in Draynor near [[Mabel]]. However, upon talking to them, the game box will say "The goblin doesn't have anything interesting to say."
